column2: interval: minutes between bands (normal, min, max; growth: how much a fast-rising prestige shortens it; jitter: random share). protection: hours after the capital and prestige before any band. lead: minutes from a band appearing to its arrival by scouting level (0, 1, 2, 3...). prestige: factors on resources lost / bandits slain. level: ranks per band level, random spread. size: how many come = base + perPrestige x prestige^exponent, give or take jitter; laneJitter / mixJitter: how unevenly they split over lanes and tiers. drops: chance a beaten band drops anything, and then how much it is worth at least (value + perLevel x (band level - 1)).
